rows.observation: The source says 'plus %d%% of your total entropy each turn', but the target has '你当前熵的 %d%%' and drops 'total'. In the frozen snippet (tome-cults/data/talents/demented/entropy.lua L228-229, source unpinned, sha256 e8046402…), edam = (eff.power * eff.dur) * t.getEntropyBonus, so the base is power × remaining duration: the total entropy left, not the current per-turn value. '当前熵' can be read as the per-turn value, and it also repeats the '当前' in '（当前 %d）'. Suggest '你的熵总量'.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults tome-cults/data/talents/demented/entropy.lua Black Hole（黑洞）info：entropy=(ENTROPIC_WASTING power×dur)×bonus，取的是剩余熵的总量，源文 your total entropy；现译“你当前熵的 %d%%”丢掉 total 且易读作每回合当前值，并与后文“（当前 %d）”重复。改为“你熵总量的 %d%%”，其余不动。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The second sentence adds a spatial scope that is not in the source. The source says 'The highest atrophy stack found will be used for the spell speed calculation' (tome-cults/data/talents/demented/chronophage.lua L166, source unpinned, sha256 6b669e4e…). The target says '会使用你周围最高层数的衰亡效果'. Nothing in the source or the frozen snippet L162-167 supports a range limit of '你周围'; the first sentence ties the stacks to the target you apply atrophy to. This adds a mechanism condition with no evidence. Suggest '将以找到的最高衰亡层数计算施法速度'.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults tome-cults/data/talents/demented/chronophage.lua Temporal Feast（时间盛宴）：施法速度按施加衰亡时各目标 eff.charges 中找到的最高层数计算（TEMPORAL_FEAST charges=eff.charges）；源文 The highest atrophy stack found 无范围限定，现译“你周围最高层数”添加了源文没有的空间范围（第315批第1轮宿主曾据半径10扫描判 refuted，今按实际取值口径与两路独立复核改判）。改为“计算施法速度增加时，会使用找到的最高衰亡层数。”，其余不动。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 材料译错：源文 steel 是「钢」，译文写成「铁手套」。同一条目 tome-orcs/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:252 的 desc 也写 "These steel gauntlets"（来源未固定）。ToME 的护手按材料分级，iron（铁）和 steel（钢）是不同的两级；写成「铁」会让未鉴定名显示错误的材料等级。应译为「钢制手套／钢铁手套」一类。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua：unided_name glistening steel gauntlets，同物品 desc 本库已作“这对钢铁手套”（tome-orcs.lua:1508）；现译“铁手套”丢失 steel 材质。改为“闪耀光辉的钢铁手套”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

reviewers.surface: codex/gpt-6-sol (8 lanes: surface-000 four Cults lanes 2/2/1/1; surface-001 four Orcs lanes 19/19/18/18)
reviewers.contextual: claude/claude-opus-5-5 (contextual-000 Cults 2 entries, contextual-001 Orcs 12 entries; 14 total)

notes: Mixed Cults+Orcs batch, attempt 2. Attempt 1 was abandoned because its Cults contextual run probed /workspace for the DLC checkout; the restart reused the batch id, and no attempt-1 finding was adopted. Surface ran as eight fresh gpt-6-sol lanes: 2/2/1/1 over Cults and 19/19/18/18 over Orcs. Lane-001-3 appended a fabricated 19th result (an OK verdict on an identity not in its envelope). The host kept the original bytes, removed only that object and harvested the corrected raw. The other seven lanes echoed their identities exactly, and the native tool scan found only reads of each lane's own envelope and the contract.
Both contextual runs (Cults 2, Orcs 12) read only their own envelope and the contract. The host scanned the native logs before harvest, so no refreeze was needed.

Temporal Feast: attempt 1's host pre-analysis refuted the added "around you" scope. Both reviewers flagged it again, and the code takes the highest stack among the targets atrophy was applied to, so the host reversed that ruling to confirmed.
Implementation-backed: Smogscreen cancels whole damage instances; Bloodstar's break conditions and halving heal are real; the one-handed-weapon check accepts any weapon.

Thunder Grenade: the code deals physical damage plus stun, so "闪电" (lightning) misleads. The name appears in three places, so the rename is recorded for the user as pending and treated as advisory here.
Mixed batch: 6 Cults and 74 Orcs entries each matched the public DLC source file SHA in the workset; source repositories and commits remain unpinned.
6 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 38 backlog from 0 to 6; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
